ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: At which stage can the earwig lay eggs?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows an earwig life cycle diagram. On the left there is a cluster of small oval eggs. At the top there is a smaller immature earwig. At the lower/right area there is a larger, fully developed earwig. Arrows connect these stages in a cycle. Since laying eggs is reproduction, and only the sexually mature adult earwig can reproduce, the earwig can lay eggs at the adult stage.
